The '''Temples of Vormijj''' were three ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temples located in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pamorjal]].

==Appearance and features==
The Temples of Vormijj were built on Pamorjal, about 180 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Beldon/Legends|Beldon]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. The three temples were next to each other, with a larger temple in the middle and two smaller ones on either side. The two smaller temples were identical and were both placed roughly 150 meters from the central temple. The central temple was about 50 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high, while the smaller temples were about 35 meters high. All three temples were four-sided pyramids, and they had steps carved into them leading to the top. All three temples were made from a [[Color/Legends|gray]] stone and were inset with [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. The largest temple contained a room with a starchart in it, with crystals representing the locations of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Pamorjal and the [[Soulsaber]].

==History==
Thousands of years before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] constructed a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] artifact called the Soulsaber, and he [[Battle of Pamorjal|fought]] a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] on Pamorjal. Many of them were slain, but the Dark Jedi was eventually defeated, and the surviving twelve Jedi Masters left with the Soulsaber to hide it. The surviving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] traveled into the jungles of Pamorjal and constructed the temples to show the way to the Soulsaber's hiding place.

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the temples had became a tourist attraction. The Dark Jedi [[Thaum Rystra]] traveled to them, to discover the location of the Soulsaber, which he sought for his master, [[Valik Kodank]]. Shortly afterward, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents who were pursuing Rystra arrived at the temples. They were attacked there by members of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], who had been tricked by Rystra into thinking that the Alliance agents posed a threat to them.
